Individually powerful and resilient, each Havoc Disciple has been molded with unique blessings by the god they follow. Stranded in the Sirius Sector, many Battle Brothers were scattered and left with little chance of survival. These desperate castaways were approached by different gods who offered powerful boons in exchange for their worship. Each god empowered their respective followers, reforging their Disciples according to their will. The Havoc Disciples are now torn between fanatical devotion to their new gods and maintaining their former discipline. On arriving in the Sirius Sector, the Founder’s fleet was scattered and damaged. Most of these ships and their crews were discounted as destroyed, but had in fact arrived safely in Sirius far from the... On a 6+ it is ignored. ### Special Rules Dangerous Terrain Debuff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which counts as being in Dangerous Terrain once (next time the effect would apply). Mend: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it. Protected: When a unit where all models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored. Shred: On unmodified results of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound. Unpredictable: When attacking, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead. Unpredictable Fighter: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead. Versatile Attack: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, when shooting or charging enemies over 9" away, all models with this rule in this unit either get AP(+1) or get +1 to hit rolls. ### Aura Special Rules Bounding Aura: This model and its unit get Bounding. Furious Aura: This model and its unit get Furious. Plaguebound Boost Aura: This model and its unit get Plaguebound Boost. Relentless Aura: This model and its unit get Relentless. Resistance Aura: This model and its unit get Resistance. Scout Aura: This model and its unit get Scout. Steadfast Aura: This model and its unit get Steadfast. Versatile Defense Aura: This model and its unit get Versatile Defense. Read more ### Spells Aura of Pestilence (1): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which counts as being in Difficult Terrain once (next time the effect would apply). Rapid Putrefaction (1): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 2 hits with AP(1) and Surge. Roll as many dice as hits to see if "on rolls of 6" effects trigger. Blessed Virus (2): Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Rapid Rush once (next time the effect would apply). Plague Malediction (2): Pick one enemy model within 24", which takes 2 hits with AP(4). This effect is resolved as if the target was a unit of [1]. Plague Boon (3): Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which get Plaguebound Boost once (next time the effect would apply). Rot Wave (3): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which takes 6 hits. ### Units ### Heroes Plague Destroyer Champion [1] Qua 3+Def 3+ 145pts Champion Heavy Rifle(24", A2, AP(1)), CCW(A4) Ambush, Hero,
